description: Implementation of cryptographic digest functions and context management in OpenSSL's BoringSSL fork, including functions for initializing, updating, finalizing, copying, and cleaning digest contexts, as well as retrieving digest properties.

methods.name: EVP_MD_type
methods.description: Returns the type identifier of the digest.

methods.name: EVP_MD_nid
methods.description: Returns the NID (numeric identifier) of the digest.

methods.name: EVP_MD_flags
methods.description: Returns the flags associated with the digest.

methods.name: EVP_MD_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the digest output.

methods.name: EVP_MD_block_size
methods.description: Returns the block size used by the digest.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_init
methods.description: Initializes the digest context to zero.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new digest context.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_create
methods.description: Alias for EVP_MD_CTX_new.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the digest context.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_cleanse
methods.description: Cleanses the digest data in the context.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees the digest context.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_destroy
methods.description: Alias for EVP_MD_CTX_free.

methods.name: EVP_DigestFinalXOF
methods.description: Finalizes digest computation for XOF (extendable output functions), not supported here.

methods.name: EVP_MD_meth_get_flags
methods.description: Retrieves flags from digest method.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_set_flags
methods.description: Sets flags on the digest context.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_copy_ex
methods.description: Copies digest context from one to another.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_move
methods.description: Moves digest context data from one to another.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_copy
methods.description: Copies digest context.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_reset
methods.description: Resets digest context to initial state.

methods.name: EVP_DigestInit_ex
methods.description: Initializes digest context with specified digest method.

methods.name: EVP_DigestInit
methods.description: Initializes digest context with specified digest method.

methods.name: EVP_DigestUpdate
methods.description: Updates digest context with data.

methods.name: EVP_DigestFinal_ex
methods.description: Finalizes digest and outputs result.

methods.name: EVP_DigestFinal
methods.description: Finalizes digest and cleans context.

methods.name: EVP_Digest
methods.description: Computes digest of data in one call.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_md
methods.description: Returns the digest method associated with the context.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the digest output.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_block_size
methods.description: Returns the block size used by the digest.

methods.name: EVP_MD_CTX_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the digest.

methods.name: EVP_add_digest
methods.description: Registers a digest method (stub implementation here).
